description: Source code for Stock Reconciliation in ERPNext, including classes, validation, ledger updates, and item handling functions.

classes.name: StockReconciliation
classes.description: Main class handling stock reconciliation process, including validation, ledger updates, and serial number management.

classes.name: OpeningEntryAccountError
classes.description: Validation error for incorrect opening entry accounts.

classes.name: EmptyStockReconciliationItemsError
classes.description: Validation error for empty or unchanged stock reconciliation items.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on stock reconciliation data, including duplicate detection and data correctness.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform upon submission, such as updating stock ledger and making GL entries.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions to perform upon cancellation, including reversing ledger entries.

methods.name: remove_items_with_no_change
methods.description: Removes items from the reconciliation list if their quantity or rate has not changed.

methods.name: validate_data
methods.description: Validates individual item data for duplicates, warehouse existence, and value constraints.

methods.name: validate_item
methods.description: Validates specific item properties such as serial number and batch requirements.

methods.name: update_stock_ledger
methods.description: Creates stock ledger entries based on item quantity and valuation differences.

methods.name: get_sle_for_serialized_items
methods.description: Generates stock ledger entries for serialized items, including serial number handling.

methods.name: update_valuation_rate_for_serial_no
methods.description: Updates purchase rates for serial numbers based on current valuation.

methods.name: get_sle_for_items
methods.description: Constructs a stock ledger entry dictionary for a given item row.

methods.name: make_sle_on_cancel
methods.description: Creates reversing stock ledger entries during cancellation.

methods.name: merge_similar_item_serial_nos
methods.description: Merges ledger entries for items with the same serial numbers and warehouse.

methods.name: get_gl_entries
methods.description: Generates general ledger entries for stock reconciliation.

methods.name: validate_expense_account
methods.description: Validates that the expense account is correctly set for inventory purposes.

methods.name: set_zero_value_for_customer_provided_items
methods.description: Sets valuation rate to zero for customer-provided items.

methods.name: set_total_qty_and_amount
methods.description: Calculates total amount and quantity differences for items.

methods.name: get_items_for
methods.description: Fetches items for a specific warehouse.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Enqueues or directly submits the stock reconciliation.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Enqueues or directly cancels the stock reconciliation.
